name: ccg
description: Codex-native CCG workflow with independent role-to-provider routing, a provider-neutral read-only product manager, opt-in external intelligence, spec, team, and quality gates. Codex remains the final implementation and verification owner.

interface.shortDescription: Run Codex-native CCG with configurable role providers and local quality gates
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native CCG fork where frontend, backend, and search independently select existing registered providers while analysis, planning, and review run inside those roles. Codex owns orchestration, implementation, and verification. External intelligence remains opt-in and GPT Pro remains manual-only. Includes bounded provider evidence, Git/context helpers, spec and team workflows, and local quality/security gates.
